info.title: GreyhoundIQ HTTP API
info.description: Source-derived contract for GreyhoundIQ Next.js route handlers. Only the local server is listed so automated security testing cannot accidentally target production. Operations marked with x-authentication-status: unknown require manual security-contract verification before release.

post.description: Accepts one registered onboarding lifecycle event only after the browser has opted into analytics. The source contract rejects identity, route, role, tier and free-form content, enforces same-origin delivery, and bounds the uncompressed body to 512 bytes.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match the request URL origin.

parameters.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
parameters.description: When supplied by the user agent, only same-origin is accepted.

parameters.name: x-greyhoundiq-analytics-consent
parameters.description: Fixed assertion emitted by the official client only while the analytics preference is accepted.

204.description: Event accepted; analytics delivery never controls the user experience.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: Exact GreyhoundIQ production origin allowed to read the response.

400.description: Invalid length, JSON or strict event schema.

403.description: Origin, fetch metadata or consent assertion rejected.

413.description: Declared or streamed request body exceeds 512 bytes.

415.description: The media type is not application/json or the body is compressed.

503.description: The required limiter dependency is unavailable.

x-known-gaps: A direct caller can assert the fixed consent header, but cannot add identity or free-form values to the strict event contract.
Deployed gateway/WAF metrics and representative global-counter contention remain unverified.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Base64url AES-256-GCM capability generated by GreyhoundIQ for an allowlisted provider target and a ten-minute expiry.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: A single bounded HTTP byte range forwarded to replay media origins.

416.description: The Range header is malformed, multi-range, reversed, or exceeds the media limit.

503.description: The bounded replay stream semaphore has no capacity for this client.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds before retrying replay admission.

503.x-exception-rationale: Replay playback is same-origin and the runtime intentionally emits no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header on its bounded overload response.
503.x-residual-risk: Cross-origin scripts cannot read Retry-After from this response; same-origin playback clients remain unaffected.

x-known-gaps: Discovered from source; security metadata and implementation trace have not been verified.

WorkOSSession.name: wos-session
WorkOSSession.description: WorkOS AuthKit session cookie; the name is source-configurable through WORKOS_COOKIE_NAME.

OnboardingAnalyticsConsent.name: x-greyhoundiq-analytics-consent
OnboardingAnalyticsConsent.description: Required fixed consent assertion for the privacy-minimised public analytics write. This is a request guard, not a user credential or authorization grant.

InternalBearer.description: Alternative internal bearer secret accepted by requireInternalRequest.

LiveKitWebhookAuthorization.description: LiveKit webhook Authorization signature verified by livekit-server-sdk.

ReplaySignature.name: t
ReplaySignature.description: Opaque authenticated encrypted replay capability containing the allowlisted provider target and expiry. Browser media requests cannot attach an Authorization header; this remains a reviewed short-lived URL credential exception.
ReplaySignature.x-residual-risk: The opaque capability can appear in access metadata and remains replayable until expiry; query values must be redacted from logs and referrers.

UnspecifiedJsonObject.description: JSON object whose exact field contract is not yet source-registered; no fields are invented.

OnboardingAnalyticsEvent.description: Exactly one registered onboarding event. Tour and step identifiers are additionally checked against the source allowlists.

CheckoutRequest.description: Checkout input accepted as JSON or browser form data; unknown fields are discarded by the source Zod object schema.

RateLimitExceeded.description: The caller exceeded the operation's bounded request policy.

Access-Control-Allow-Origin.description: The exact production web origin allowed to read this response.

Cache-Control.description: Prevents shared or browser caches from storing the caller-specific denial.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the active fixed window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the active window, clamped to zero through the configured limit.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Whole delta-seconds until the active window resets; never less than one.

Retry-After.description: Whole delta-seconds before the caller should retry; equal to RateLimit-Reset.

x-generation-evidence.generatedAt: source-derived; timestamp intentionally omitted for deterministic output
